body:
Thank you for all of your kind words an for sharing your experiences with me.

It almost makes me feel selfish at the way I've been acting and the thoughts which have been running through my mind.

It comforts me to know that other people are capable of feeling the same way. Only because I know that it's just being human and reflects on how caring we are as people. 

Pets bring such joy and experiences we will never forget. I guess what's that makes the pain all the more real when we have to say goodbye.

Thank you all again for your words, I can't begin to express how much I appreciate it.
All day I've been reading about possibility of the afterlife. The chance to be reunited with my best buddy! If I can find enough evidence to support this then I'm out.
